fix_commit_msg:
Fix tval reported values in some exception cases (#3226)

* Set tval to zero on ecall
See https://github.com/openhwgroup/cva6/issues/3019

* Set tval to instruction address on ebreak
See https://github.com/openhwgroup/cva6/issues/3019

* Report target not pc in tval on misaligned jump
See https://github.com/openhwgroup/cva6/issues/3018
